en.title: The Robot That Thinks Before It Acts: How NeoVerse-ABot Solved Action Hallucination at ICRA 2026
en.summary: The Chinese Academy of Sciences' NeoVerse-ABot team won the World Model track at ICRA 2026 with a 0.829 score, solving the 'action hallucination' problem that plagued robot world models — enabling robots to simulate physical outcomes in their 'mind' before acting.

zh.title: 先想后动：中科院 NeoVerse-ABot 破解机器人「动作幻觉」难题，夺 ICRA 2026 世界模型冠军
zh.summary: 中国科学院自动化研究所 NeoVerse-ABot 团队在 ICRA 2026 世界模型赛道以 0.829 分夺冠，526 支队伍中排名第一。核心突破是解决了机器人世界模型的「动作幻觉」问题——让机器人能在行动前在「脑海」中准确推演物理结果。
